name: Iran 1998
authors: 414th Joint Fighter Group (derived from Khopa's Iran 2015)
description:
The Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force and Air Defence Force at the end of the 1990s, for the Afghanistan - Islam Qala campaign.

Two things define it. Half the combat fleet is Iraqi: the Su-24MK, Mirage F1EQ, Su-22M4, Su-25 and a share of the MiG-29s are aircraft that flew to Iran during the 1991 Gulf War and never went home. And the F-14A is the Shah's, kept flying for twenty years without American parts.

It has no tanker and no AEW aircraft, because Iran had neither. Its entire air picture is ground radar, so the early-warning chain is the whole of its command and control. Air defence is the pre-revolution Western kit (I-Hawk, Rapier) layered with Soviet and Chinese systems (S-75, S-200, HQ-2, SA-6) and heavy AAA. There is no double-digit SAM.
